note: Away digest phase 1, the Basis line (review of the away-digest fix round 2): the measure's git line counts commits ahead only against an upstream. A branch with no upstream (a new local or worktree branch, a detached HEAD) says `no upstream`, one whose upstream ref is gone says `upstream gone`, never `ahead 0 behind 0`, so lane.ts renders the commits not pushed as unknown, not 0

steps.name: main tracks origin/main, one commit on top: ahead 1

stdout_has: ^git: branch main · HEAD [0-9a-f]{12} · 0 changed · ahead 1 behind 0$

steps.name: a new local branch with no upstream: no upstream, not ahead 0

stdout_has: ^git: branch feat/new · HEAD [0-9a-f]{12} · 0 changed · no upstream$

steps.name: a branch whose upstream was deleted on the remote: upstream gone

stdout_has: ^git: branch merged · HEAD [0-9a-f]{12} · 0 changed · upstream gone$

steps.name: a detached HEAD with a changed file: no upstream
